sources.title: The Witcher 4 Will Have a Comparable Leap From GTA 5 to GTA 6, Says CD Projekt Red
sources.text: CD Projekt Red expects a leap between The Witcher 3 and 4 that is comparable to the one between GTA 5 and 6. In a recent earnings call (via Eurogamer ), CDPR was peppered with questions about GTA 6, since the developer also makes ambitious open-world games. CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski was asked whether or not the studio is looking at GTA for inspiration and if people can expect a similar leap between games. He noted that they have, indeed, observed the jump between GTA 5 and 6 before stating that fans can expect something comparable for The Witcher 4. "We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 — I think so, yes," he said. "It's been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." The leap between GTA 5 and 6 is pretty absurd. There's a significant number of more things to do, particularly for those interested in roleplaying as a criminal. You can steal drugs, rob banks, knock over virtually any store on the map, and so much more. A lot of these details were either reserved for scripted missions in GTA 5 or were underbaked as open-world activities, but are fully fleshed out for you to do however you want in GTA 6. Advancements in NPCs, interactivity, immersion, and the ability to enter hundreds of interiors also make GTA 6 feel a world apart from its predecessor. Will The Witcher 4 also have tons of enterable interiors or deeper interactions with random NPCs? It's too soon to tell. It's possible that the leap for CD Projekt Red could come in a number of other ways, as The Witcher is a totally different world from GTA, after all. Maybe monster hunting will be more nuanced and involved than in The Witcher 3, similar to how GTA 6 has more engaging criminal activities. CDPR also noted that it plans to find ways to expand the game to more mainstream audiences, like GTA 6 has. GTA 6 collaborated with major mainstream artists to create original music, in addition to bold marketing campaigns that made the game difficult to ignore. The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release , and we can probably expect more looks at the game next year. CDPR also noted that it has signed a marketing agreement with PlayStation for the game, which will also cover previous games and allow for opportunities with PlayStation Plus' services. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

sources.title: The difference between The Witcher 3 and Witcher 4 will be 'comparable' to that of GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt boss says: 'I mean, it's been 11 years'
sources.text: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6. CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way. "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences. "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time. Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable: At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do." He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason. "You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero." Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments." "I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.' "They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that." Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." sources.title: Cyberpunk 2 Development Ramps Up At CD Projekt Red, But Ambitions For The Project Are ‘Not Changed’ By GTA 6′s Success
sources.text: CD Projekt Red Cyberpunk 2077 Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 The Witcher 4 While the eyes of the world are focused on Grand Theft Auto VI , the rest of games industry must continue on in its wake. Yesterday, CD Projekt Red held its latest financial briefing, updating investors on the progress of both its long-running hits and its upcoming titles, sharing news that Cyberpunk 2 ‘s development team has grown to nearly 200. And given the overlap between CDPR’s games with their elaborate open worlds and those of GTA 6 , investors wanted to know how the latter’sÂ phenomenal success will impact the studio’s work. Polish studio CD Projekt Red is known for its work on open-world adventures like The Witcher and Cyberpunk , and during the briefing investorsÂ asked whether the success of GTA will impact the design process and development of those series. CDPR explained that as much as the game is an “inspiration” to them, there is no need to adjust the development road maps for its upcoming games in response to the success of Rockstarâs work. “We have certain ambitions when it comes to The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2 , but they have not changed when it comes to GTA 6 ,” was the response given to an investor. “It’s always great to see games like that because they show you how much cool stuff can be done. That’s for sure an inspiration in many ways for our developers.â That being said, if there were to be a comparison between the works of the two studios, CD Projekt Red believes that the long development time between The Witcher 3 and 4 has led to a comparable leap in fidelity for the company’s fantasy role-playing series to that seen between GTA 5 and 6 . Excluding the recent release of The Witcher 3 Remastered on modern consoles in September, CDPR’s last major video game release was 2020’s Cyberpunk 2077 . Yet despite not having put out a new game in six years, revenue for the company has only grown, and anticipation for its work remains high. The release of The Witcher 3 Remastered saw the game record its highest concurrent player count in its history, with 138,000 players at once, despite the core game being over a decade old. This is something the company credits to its work bringing in new players via broad multimedia expansion. The Witcher has received numerous TV series with Netflix, while the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners anime made in collaboration with Studio Trigger recently premiered its second season. CDPR noted that the show reached the top 10 in 55 countries on its release and debuted third on the streaming serviceâs global top 10. More importantly for the studio, it brought people back to playing Cyberpunk 2077 , coinciding with a new update tied to the anime’s story. CDPR stated that âthe anime brings people to the franchise, and the update gives them a reason to play.â The anime boosted the gameâs concurrent player count across all platforms to over 2.1 million players, triple where it was before the anime’s second season premiered. Roughly half of the studio (513 out of 1051 developers) is now working on The Witcher 4 ahead of a planned 2028 release, with 199 developers working on Cyberpunk 2 , a slight increase from earlier this year. This has led to the team working on the studio’s Witcher spin-off, currently titled Sirius , shrinking slightly from 84 developers to a team of 60, while a new IP known as Hadar Â remains in development with a smaller team. sources.title: CD Projekt Red signs new marketing partnership deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and to increase "the presence" of its games on PlayStation
sources.text: As part of The Witcher and Cyberpunk studio CD Projekt Red's recent Q3 earnings report, the developer offered some updates on upcoming game The Witcher 4 . During an earnings call yesterday, the studio revealed it had signed a new partnership deal with Sony regarding marketing rights to The Witcher 4, as well as to extend "the presence" of CD Projekt Red's other games across the PlayStation Store and PlayStation Plus. "Just today, we signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign," said studio CFO Piotr Nielubowicz . "This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years." Nielubowicz didn't elaborate on what exactly that means for The Witcher 4's marketing, but perhaps it could enable Sony to advertise the action-RPG as a PlayStation game, similar to the Grand Theft Auto 6 'plays best on PlayStation' campaign . But seeing as The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release , we may not find out what form that agreement takes for some time. That said, looking at similar marketing agreements from Sony's recent history, we can probably expect The Witcher 4 to show up during Sony State of Play presentations or even have dedicated PlayStation-focused showcases. The Witcher 4 footage may also be specified as being captured on PlayStation hardware - something we already saw with The Witcher 4 tech demo last year . Perhaps we'll see Witcher-themed accessories and PlayStation hardware, too. This is a notable shift for CDPR, which has historically had close ties to Xbox. Cyberpunk 2077's big Keanu Reeves reveal (as Johnny Silverhand) took place on Xbox's E3 2019 stage , and The Witcher 3 's reveal happened on Microsoft's E3 2013 stage. Going further back, Xbox 360 was the only console The Witcher 2 was released on. During the same earnings call, CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski said that we should expect the leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 to be similar to that between GTA 5 and GTA 6 , while also praising Rockstar's approach to marketing its record-breaking new game.

sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . sources.title: GTA 6: How to flip a car in Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: How to flip a car in the open world and reset your car in races in Grand Theft Auto 6 It happens to the best of us. You were driving down the road in Grand Theft Auto 6, and what shouldâve been a tiny tap turned into you flipping your car. At least youâre still alive, right? Back in the PS2 days, simply turning the wheel to the side would have your car correct itself and flip back onto all four wheels, but itâs not so easy in GTA 6 thanks to that pesky ârealism.â In this guide, weâre breaking down how to flip cars back over in Grand Theft Auto 6 â this can also be used to push boats into the water and more. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Right, so hereâs the scenario: you were speeding down the highway, and you clipped another vehicle, sending you spinning out and rolling down the road sideways. Youâre alive, but you want to get back in your car and go, only itâs upside down. These things happen, and luckily, the developers give you a way to right your car. As Jason or Lucia, all you need to do is walk into the side of the car until your character changes to a pushing animation. Once in this animation, you can press X ( Xbox ) or Square ( PS5 ) to perform a Shove animation. Both Jason and Lucia are surprisingly strong, and a Shove should push your car over and onto its wheels, as long as you are pushing from the side. You can also use the same technique to push a beached boat back into the water. If youâre in a race, you canât leave your vehicle. Bad crashes happen in races especially, and the somewhat awkward physics of the game can make that happen more often than you might deserve. Hopefully a patch smooths that out in the future. In the meantime, if you have a bad crash in a race where your car gets flipped, or you crash and get entirely turned around, you can hold the Back button (Xbox) or the Touch Pad button (PS5) to “Reset” your car onto the road, facing the correct direction. These crashes have the potential to ruin your race, though. If that happens, you might want to go to the pause menu and select the Restart Event option.

sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.title: All GTA 6 Kitty Litter lab locations
sources.text: Take Out Kitty Litter for Tyrone across the Vice City. Taking Out Kitty Litter's lab locations in GTA 6 is a mission in Tyrone's questline, and sees you searching the city for 18 secret labs (after the first one he directs you to). Every lab has a red smoking chimney and a blue and white Spin On This laundry van parked outside. It'll take a little while, but it's well worth it to get the unique gold SMG at the end. Plus, Tyrone will start buying narcotics from you for the highest price possible. To destroy each lab, simply shoot a smoking pink flask and then run away. I've also laid these out in the most optimal order , separated into regions, so you're not driving back and forth across Vice City. Last note: if you want to unlock map markers for the labs yourself versus relying on these videos, you can threaten cooks in certain labs to potentially reveal them. After you complete some missions for Tyrone (when you meet him with Dre'Quan during Dealer's Choice ) he'll direct you to this trailer park in La Perle where you destroy the first Kitty Litter lab and start the hunt for the others. You can see the route to the lab in the video above. You can find this one in the trailer park opposite Zenon's Pawn Shop Ammu-Nation in La Perle. As soon as you go through the main gate, you can see the trailer with the funnel chimney where they're cooking straight ahead. Sneak around the back and break inside to find the lab. Or take out the three guys in front and go in that way. Just across the road from the Mezzasega Espresso and Slinger in the Decor District. Pull off to the right of the road into the Williams + Whitaker Homeware and Decor car park. You'll see a garage with a shutter at the far end with a smoking chimney and the laundry van parked. Open the shutter to find a lone guy in the lab. This one is behind Peterson's Autoshop in Rockridge, directly south across the road from the Blessed Food Market, under the overpass, on the border between Rockridge and La Perle. Head through the main yard and turn left to spot the laundry van. Break into it, move it forward, and open the shutter behind to find the lab. Just east of Fleeca Field stadium, next door to Xero Gas - Rockridge. You'll spot the blue and white laundry van parked off to the side of the road behind a wall. Head down that alley and turn right to find a garage door you can open with the lab inside. On the east side of the condominium building directly south of the Vice City Hospital, by Emilio's Auto Center Gas. Look for the closed road with the laundry van parked at the southern end and some staircases and flats off to the side with the chimney spewing smoke. The lab is through the white door on the bottom floor. Just down the road to the west of Bump and Grind coffee and Salon Belle, in a block of flats southeast of Fleeca Fields stadium. sources.title: GTA 6: All Criminal Profiles explained
sources.text: All Criminal Profiles and how they change the game in Grand Theft Auto 6 Grand Theft Auto 6 sports a new feature known as Criminal Profiles. A bit like a Hitman or Metal Gear Solid game, your actions across missions and the open world are actually ranked and weighted. For example, do you go non-lethal for most missions, or are you happy to gun down a few hostiles? In fact, if an enemy is already downed, do you go for the kill to finish them off? What if the people youâre attacking arenât even enemies, but just people who were minding their own business in Leonida? All of these factors are taken into consideration and build your Criminal Profile. In this guide, weâre explaining all of the Criminal Profiles and what changes about the game if you earn them in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Jason and Lucia are criminals. Thatâs an unavoidable part of the story, but what kind of criminals they are is up to you. How many kills you get in missions, and how many you get in the open world, impacts your Criminal Profile and eventually will impact the options you can take and the buffs you get. For example, a Professional profile will give you a Focus buff whenever you get a non-lethal takedown. On the other hand, Violent profiles will give you a Focus buff for headshots. As a result, the more you lean into a specific playstyle, the harder it can be to go back. You may also lose your ability to surrender or negotiate with cops. If you want a Professional profile, you need to take down foes non-lethally, and if possible, commit crimes without even getting spotted. If you achieve perfect stealth time and time again, youâll eventually achieve the Professional profile. With the Professional profile, non-lethal takedowns will give you a Focus buff. A Hardened profile proves that youâre willing to use force â and even kill â to get the job done. Taking down enemies generally wonât make you drop into a Violent profile â unless youâre killing foes that are already down â but you will slip into a Violent profile if you make a habit of killing civilians and police. Friendly actions and non-lethal takedowns will give you a Focus buff as a Hardened criminal. If you have a Violent profile, it means youâve been killing cops and civilians needlessly, or even shooting foes that are already downed. Once youâve slipped into a Violent profile, itâs difficult to go back to Hardened without some serious behaviour changes. With a Violent profile, headshots will give you a Focus buff. Youâll drop into a Psycho profile if youâre regularly killing domesticated animals, civilians, and police. This is a point of no return of sorts â as a Psycho criminal, you can still redeem yourself by going non-lethal in future missions. Go any further, and there’s no turning back. As a Psycho criminal, you will lose the ability to surrender to cops, but headshots will still give you a Focus buff. Once you hit Irredeemable status, the narrative of the game will permanently change. Jason and Luciaâs story will come to a different conclusion, and it is impossible to go back to a Psycho profile or anything gentler. There are no buffs for being irredeemable, so you should avoid this at all costs.

sources.text: Modders are racing to get Grand Theft Auto VI running on PC. Modders are racing to get Grand Theft Auto VI running on PC. Game modding communities are racing to get Grand Theft Auto VI running on PC, but one big effort has been taken down by Take-Two today. Leonida, a fan project by 15-year-old “NotRexed,” has vanished after a DMCA takedown notice from GTA VI publisher Take-Two. Leonida was designed to translate a leaked GTA VI Xbox build to run natively on Windows. Cyberleek, the leaker who posted multiple GTA VI gameplay videos over the summer, published a full Xbox build of the game earlier this week. The leak has kicked recompilation efforts up a notch, as modders race to reverse-engineer the game’s code and rebuild it into native PC code. Some have managed to get the game to boot on PC, but recompiling the full game won’t be easy — even with help from AI tools like Claude. Take-Two is trying to slow this progress, and its IP enforcement team targeted the main GitHub repository for Leonida and more than 2,900 forks of it, claiming that it “infringes upon Take-Two’s copyrighted works and facilitates copyright infringement of Rockstar Games title, Grand Theft Auto VI .” PortWatch VI is tracking the efforts to recompile, emulate, or port the leaked Xbox build over to PC. At the time of publishing, the VIctory project and forks of it are leading the way. People are also trying to use XCL, a compatibility layer that runs Xbox Series X games on a Windows PC, to get GTA VI running. At this point, it seems like Take-Two might not be able to avoid the inevitable here. The clock started ticking down to the release of the PC version last week, and if recent reports are true, we might see it in a few months. If GTA VI is close to being officially ready for PC, we could hear about a release before modders manage to get the game running on PC unofficially.

sources.title: The race to port GTA 6 to PC, explained
sources.text: GTA 6 could be a PC game (illegally) in a matter of days. Things are moving fast. Now that an illicit Xbox build of GTA 6 is out in the wild, anonymous modders are racing to port it to PC, and the work is progressing faster than many expected. At this rate, it's possible that a static recompilation of GTA 6 will run on a PC in a matter of days. It's also possible it will take much longer to produce a playable build that's actually on par with the console versions. What we do know for sure is that Rockstar is taking notice and has already begun cracking down on the highest-profile projects. As always, downloading pirated software is illegal and can infect your PC with malware, and that last bit is doubly true in the dubious AI era we now live in. For now, the only thing to do is observe and report. Here's where things stand with GTA 6 PC ports. Several projects have made it as far as booting the game and using menus, and at least one has seemingly managed to move around in-game with bugged out lighting , but it's hard to verify clips making the rounds when so many are obvious fakes . Dozens of groups of anonymous modders and vibecoders. So many, in fact, that several websites dedicated to tracking the progress of GTA 6 recomp efforts have also appeared. One of the tracker sites, Portwatch VI , has a list of projects ranked by their "playable" completion percentage—best not to take those made up figures as an accurate estimate of when a port will be complete. The top five are: Until very recently, the Leonida project was among those making impressive progress, but the group's creator (a 15-year-old) quit the project after Rockstar got its Discord server taken down. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. Every GTA 6 recomp project is based on the same thing: An illicit Xbox build of GTA 6 released online by Cyberleek , the notorious leaker who previously shared video of a GTA 6 development build months before its release. With GTA 6 being the biggest game in the world at the moment and not available on PC, there is an outsized motivation to get it running. A recomp refers to static recompilation, which is the result of reverse-engineering a game's code to make it run on other hardware (usually a PC). If you want to read further on how that's achieved, PCG alum Wes Fenlon's excellent Read Only Memo newsletter has what you're looking for. As for how GTA 6 ports (and ports for other new games) are coming together so quickly, the answer is AI. The advent of AI coding tools like Claude have greatly expedited the work required to create a static recompilation of games on another platform. What used to take months to years now takes hours to days. Recomps that heavily use AI are often buggier, messier, and have fewer features than human-made fan projects, but they are fast and functional. It's way too early to speak in absolutes, but I'm comfortable assuming that the first "playable" recomps will require an exceptionally powerful PC. That guess is based on GTA 6 being an obviously demanding game and also some recent precedent: The earliest Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake recomps that've appeared online have high system requirements to perform as well as it does natively on Switch 2—and, well, GTA 6 has a lot more happening under the hood than a 28-year-old Zelda game. That's the big question. My money is on no, it won't. To switch up plans on a dime would assume that Rockstar is sitting on a polished PC version that it could put out any day, and I'm not convinced that's the case. The current rumor, preceding all of this leak business, is that the PC version of GTA 6 is planned for Q1 2027 (so anytime before April). That's not to say Rockstar couldn't expedite the process if it wanted to—they certainly have the resources to achieve the unlikely. sources.text: All the endings (and a couple variations) for GTA 6 we've seen so far. Obviously, massive spoilers follow for GTA 6 endings! There are multiple endings to GTA 6 , and while we haven't experienced them all personally here at PC Gamer, the gaming community has been sharing them around for anyone curious about what they may have missed. The ending you get depends on the choices you make during the final GTA 6 story mission , but also depends on how you handled Jason and Lucia's romance and criminal profiles throughout the game, so seeing every version of the ending would mean not just playing the ending multiple times, but having different playthroughs of the game altogether. There are a couple of endings that I don't consider "different" from each other but do have some differences leading up to them, which I'll explain below. There may also be additional endings we haven't seen yet, so we may update this guide in the future. In the bridge endings, Jason and Lucia have defeated Mendez and his squad and gotten the hard drive back from Georgio's penthouse and escaped. They drive to Cal's place in Key Lento, but discover he has been compromised. They drive to the bridge, but the cops have set up a roadblock and have the couple trapped. Lucia wants to keep going, but Jason suggests they jump off the bridge and swim for it. A choice comes up on the screen: "Swim For it" or "No Surrender." Jason and Lucia try to run the roadblock and are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, we see that their son Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children. Jason and Lucia are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, their lawyer, Abe, brings the money to Lucia's aunt. Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children in a much bigger house than the other No Surrender ending. Choosing "Swim for it" presents an additional choice. When Jason gets out of the car, Lucia can choose to "Exit" the car with him, or change her mind by not choosing it. Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. They both exit the car without holding guns. Lucia jumps, but Jason doesn't jump and is arrested. Lucia signs a deal for immunity while Jason goes to prison. Lucia gets a job in a diner. Lucia takes Tomas to meet Jason in prison, but he can only see his son through a glass divider. Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. Jason exits the car with a gun, but Lucia changes her mind and stays in the car. The police open fire and Jason and Lucia are both shot to death. Tomas lives with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children. Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it, Jason doesn't jump and is arrested. Two years later, Lucia uses the savings account to get Jason freed from prison. Lucia goes to the prison to pick up Jason. Jason meets Tomas and holds his hand. If you don't have a strong relationship between Jason and Lucia, there is a different ending location: the base of Georgio's tower. In these endings, the couple never makes it to the bridge. You can also choose to break up the couple, either as Jason or as Lucia, as you begin the mission Protective Custody. After the tower fight with Georgio's men, police confront the couple at the base of the tower. The police open fire and Jason pushes Lucia down. Jason is shot. Lucia has a choice to "Stay down" or "Defend Jason". She stays down and watches Jason die. Lucia is arrested, signs a deal, and visits Tomas at her aunt's house. Lucia then leaves Tomas with her aunt, takes out a gun, and continues her life of crime by preparing to rob a diner. After the tower fight with Georgio's men, police confront them at the base of the tower. The police open fire and Jason pushes Lucia down. Jason is shot. Lucia chooses "Defend Jason" and fights the cops. They die together. On the way down to ground level at the tower, Jason decides to run. Lucia is arrested and signs the deal, then lives with her aunt and Tomas while working in a diner. One night there's a knock on the door and she finds a bag of cash on the porch. We see Jason driving away with... Rocco the drug-sniffing dog from earlier in the game. Sure, that might as well happen. How to get this ending (sourced by GamingwithTZ on YouTube ): Jason and Lucia make a deal with Mendez after defeating him. Once they have the hard drive, they're surrounded by cops at the bottom of the tower. Mendez arrives and takes them away in his car, then drives them to the swamp. Later in the credits, we see two skulls in the swamp, side-by-side, with a bullet hole in each. Note : You may need a specific criminal profile for this ending. I tried to take the deal (as Lucia) in one of my ending playthroughs, but Jason shot Mendez anyway. I had both Jason and Lucia at "Professional" level criminal profiles. This ending was not available to me. Speculation, but this ending may only be available if you don't have "Professional" as your criminal profiles. There are potentially (and almost certainly) more endings to GTA 6. There are still a few combinations of all the different variables, including your romance level, criminal profile level, amount of money saved, and the choices you make during the final mission, that we haven't seen yet. We'll update this guide if the community finds more endings. sources.title: How to steal the GTA 6 Schafter v12
sources.text: The GTA 6 Schafter v12 is not what you might think, which is what makes this theft tricky at first If you're having trouble heisting the GTA 6 Schafter v12 for Raul, it's easier than you might think. The problem is that you've gotten used to stealing cars for Moses in GTA 6 Chapter 1, but now you're working for Raul, and his jobs are a little more... unusual. So, if you're driving away from the scene of the crime in a hot new motor, police on your tail, wondering why you're being told your job's not done, here's where you might be going wrong when trying to steal the Schafter v12 in GTA 6. If you're struggling with this mission, the problem is most likely that you're stealing the wrong car. You should be looking for the shabby green car parked under the canopy with its trunk roof missing. Having been keeping an eye out for so many nice cars by this point, be it for yourself, for Moses, or for Raul, you're lulled into a false sense of security. You go into this mission all guns blazing, literally, thinking you know what's up and that you don't need to waste time Wainking it. That stunning muscle car with the growling exposed engine and massive exhausts must be the car you're after, right? Wrong. Clearly placed here to lead you astray on purpose, that's actually the strangely reasonably priced Imponte Bloodbath Phoenix, so I recommend heading back to the area and taking that one for yourself later. For the Car Service mission, however, you'll need to drive away in the crumbling Benefactor Shafter v12. Other than that, the only trouble you'll meet with this mission is the same as ever: a few criminals with weapons ready to be drawn. The best way to complete this one is to head onto the roof from round the back of the gated area before taking them all out with a silenced handgun, which I recommend for most small-to-medium heists at this stage. If you're looking for more cars to steal for yourself, make sure you pick up the Paul Walker GTA 6 car , inspired by the 1995 Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse. And don't skip over the pink Porsche in GTA 6 , which you can only get if you pay attention in Chapter 2. © GamesRadar+. Not to be reproduced without permission. sources.title: How to steal the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular in GTA 6
sources.text: One of the cars Randy wants in GTA 6 is the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular—and don't let the name fool you, its a slick and speedy ride that'll you'll be tempted to keep for yourself. But Randy doesn't know the locations of many of the cars on his wishlist, and can't point you to the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular: you just need to keep an eye out for it. Luckily, we spotted it ourselves, so just follow the simple steps below to find it. Head to Belville : It's a town in Leonard County, in the central eastern part of the map, a bit south of Lake Leonida and north of La Perle. In the northern edge of Belville there's a little cluster of four homes laid out almost in an X pattern. The southernmost home of that cluster has a garage you can break into. Once you open the garage door, you'll see the white Ocelot Bloodless Jugular. You'll need the key cloner to get in, which I assume you already have since you're doing jobs for Randy. No need to worry about the tracker , it's a standard one so it won't transmit your location to the cops. You still don't want to dawdle, because the owner of the car has a gun and he's not afraid to use it. He'll start shooting if he sees you boost the car. Randy will pay you $10,615 for the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular. He'll pay an extra $5,000 if you bring it to him in pristine condition. sources.title: Here’s How To Get A Banshee In GTA 6 And Unlock A GTA 3-Inspired Trophy
sources.text: Obviously, you need to steal cars in Grand Theft Auto 6 ; itâs in the name of the game. But you might as well get something out of it beyond just new wheels and some money, so how about scoring a trophy along the way? The Bravado Banshee is a nice ride that you get a mission to steal in GTA 6âs third chapter, via a character named Randy. You could luck out and find a Banshee on the street, but if you want the Capital Offense trophy, you can kill two birds with one stone by hitting up the Sunrise Premium Autos showroom in Southside. Youâll find it between Vice City International Airport and Peacock Bay, next to an Illegals Good Store. Note that you canât do this before you do Randyâs mission âCloninâ Keys, Makinâ Gs.â Why? The Bravado Banshee, like a lot of expensive cars in the game, requires a key cloner , and Randy is the person who gives you one as part of that mission. After he’s added the app to your phone, you can head to Sunrise Premium Autos and walk back to the showroom where a shiny blue Bravado Banshee is just sitting there. Clone the key via the same method you would use to slim-jim a car door, and then step on in. The next part is how you get the Capital Offense trophy: Drive the car straight through the glass window and then gun it before the police get there. The trophy should pop immediately. The trophy itself is a reference to the easiest and most reliable way to get a Banshee in Grand Theft Auto 3 , where you would just visit a car showroom in the south part of the map, sit in a Banshee in the showroom, and then drive it through the glass window. The similarity to that setup here in GTA 6 seems to be a pretty direct reference to the now-25-year-old PS2 title.Â You can either give the Banshee to Randy for that mission or get it repainted and registered for yourself. And you can return later to this same spot and get another Banshee! Regardless of what you choose, youâre a bit richer and a bit further along in your progress toward a platinum trophy or a mythic achievement. Not bad for an afternoonâs work. sources.title: How to get abducted and find aliens in GTA 6
sources.text: To find aliens in GTA 6 you need to be abducted, then wait for dream to tell you what to do next The GTA 6 alien mission starts with an abduction that leads to some weird dreams, and eventually sends you off to literally find what's out there. Spoilers obviously abound for everything I'm about to tell you below, but if you want to see what the latest instalment of Grand Theft Auto's alien stuff is, read on. To start everything off you first need to be abducted. There's an element of luck here but what you're looking is to see a car by the side of the road with all its doors open and lights going crazy . It seems like there might be a few locations it can happen, and it can only happen at night, but for me it was here in Port Gellhorn: Follow the cars headlights and you should see some clothes scattered around. Using your flashlight and Focus you'll see more clothes making a trail you can follow. Eventually you'll see a light, and pick up something... else with your Focus. I won't spoil it too much: Once this sequence plays out you'll get the objective to go back to the woman's car. This is what triggers your own abduction experience. Once that's done you'll wake up by the side of the road apparently unharmed. To continue the GTA 6 alien quest you'll need to go to sleep to trigger some dreams. It might take a day or two but keep sleeping and you should eventually have some strange dreams. It needs to be the same character that was abducted, obviously, in case you're not seeing anything happen. This dream is actually an explainer on how to rescue an alien, although there's a tricky puzzle to get past first. Leaving the room you woke up in will take you to a large dark room full of eggs with a bright light at the center. The eggs will explode if you get too close, and once a few have popped you'll be grabbed by a tentacle. This will restart the dream with the option to 'give up', but don't. If you're having trouble all you need to do is sneak past slowly. If you crouch and keep your speed as low as possible you shouldn't pop any eggs, no matter how angry they look. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more You'll need to find a path through the eggs as it's a bit of a maze, but as long you move low and slow you should be able to reach the light in the middle easily, which will end this sequence. Once past the alien eggs you'll reach a room with a model solar system in it. The Earth is actually a picture of a location, so examine that and move on. Next you'll see a keypad with a series of lines over it. These lines denote the alien key pad code and are randomised. For me it was 3214 but you might have something different. Don't worry about memorising it, as it will be noted like the GTA 6 safe codes you can find elsewhere. Once you're through you'll find a control panel to use. Switch it on and you'll see four buttons you'll need to turn green: Pushing any button will cycle the light either side of it through off, orange and then green. Using that info you'll need to make all the lights green and then press another button to reveal three doors ahead of you. Through to door on the left you'l find some milk to fetch, and through the door on the right you'll find a machine you can put the milk in. The door in the middle has a burning sun inside that will kill you. We don't open the middle door. Get the milk and take it to the machine. Placing it in the slot will then end this whole sequence and you'll wake up. The radio tower you saw in your dream is at the location shown on the map above - just above Shoeless Keys. Drive there and use your car to encourage the gates to open, as there's barbed wire everywhere. Go around the building to this door and head inside: Immediately inside you'll see some stairs down to a door locked with a keypad. Use the code you got in your dream to open it. This will then take you down via lift to a control room where you'll find a tape you can play on a table, and then repeat what you learned in the dream: Putting the milk in the machine will open the door and reveal the alien. However, make sure you have full health before you pick it up. The second you grab the ET poison gas will start flooding the place, and you'll need to get to the lift as fast as possible while your health drains. Head outside and let the events play out. When it's all over you'll have your health, stamina and focus all permanently increased. For reasons your car will probably be impounded and end up at the police station nearest your current home. If you are miles from home at this point, simply switch to the other character and then call up and arrange to meet. This will teleport whoever was stranded immediately back to you. © GamesRadar+. sources.title: How to steal an ATM and get a winched vehicle in GTA 6
sources.text: Yank out ATMs and grab the cash with Yasmani's tips. Stealing an ATM in GTA 6 requires a few different things: a winched vehicle to haul it out of the wall and drive off, plus the dye pack jammer that stops marked bills from exploding pink all over your lovely cash. There are two ways to get a winched truck. The video above shows a location at the crop duster landing strip in Frogswater where you can steal one, but you can also mod any truck at a mod shop to add a winch. If you don't have a truck to mod, there's a unique one you can steal from the Kolt & Associates June Warehouse robbery in Port Gellhorn, just south of Sarena's Bargain Store, which you could then register with Moses and mod at Wasteland Off-Road in the north of the town. You'll also need the dye pack jammer, which you get in the Chapter 3 main mission, Credit Check, for Raul. Once you have both of these, you're ready to rob an ATM. If you complete all three of Yasmani's jewelry thefts (also in Chapter 3), he'll call a little later and offer tips about full ATMs, giving you three for free that you have a 24 hour window to hit. Here's how to steal them For Yasmani's tipped-off ATMs I got about 11k-ish per time, so not terrible, but likely not the best way to make money unless you get really efficient at it and invest in a proper getaway winch truck.
